title: Zoning map change for Park Avenue, Brooklyn
summary: This land use application would amend the zoning map to rezone an area near Park Avenue in Brooklyn from manufacturing districts (M1-1 and M1-2) to mixed manufacturing-residential districts (M1-4/R6-1 and M1-4/R7D) and establish a Special Mixed Use District. The change affects property in Brooklyn Community District 3, Council District 33, and could allow new residential and commercial development alongside manufacturing uses.
